candidate.educational_objective: Recognize uterine tachysystole as an important obstetric adverse effect of misoprostol.

options.A: Uterine tachysystole with possible adverse fetal heart rate changes.
options.B: Profound hypoglycemia as the primary obstetric toxicity.
options.D: Isolated maternal bradycardia without uterine effects.

candidate.rationale: With obstetric use, misoprostol can cause uterine tachysystole; excessive uterine activity can impair uteroplacental blood flow and be accompanied by adverse fetal heart rate changes. Uterine activity and fetal status therefore require close monitoring.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Obstetric misoprostol use can cause uterine tachysystole and associated fetal heart rate abnormalities.
candidate.source_locator: Labor and Delivery—uterine tachysystole and fetal heart rate effects; monitoring of uterine and fetal status
candidate.stem: A client receives misoprostol for cervical ripening before labor induction. Which complication should the nurse monitor for closely?
